note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #9, Q3 2025 Public Safety Perception; exports mexico_2025_q3safety_perception.csv) keeps the 59 INEGI columns bp1_1..bp1_9_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (import delimited case(lower); id = _n within 2025 Q3) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); keep list identical to Q1 2025's Bookmark #1. Recodes: 9 -> missing on every bp1_* except the 0/1 bp1_6_* set; 3 (No aplica) -> missing on bp1_2_*, bp1_5_*, bp1_7_*. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 0925 data dictionary labels every BP1_* column (e.g. BP1_2_03 'Percepcion de seguridad en la calle'; BP1_2_12 '...en el parque o centro recreativo'; BP1_5_4 '...permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as) por temor a sufrir algun delito'; BP1_6_07 '...: SMS o alertas por celular'); 59/59 labels agree in content with the Q3 questionnaire sub-item/option carrying the same number; all 59 catalogos/bp1_*.csv are identical to the 0325 (Q1 2025) catalogos, so the 144 option_text values carried from batch_692 are unchanged catalogo/print labels. Step 3b, 2025 Q3 vs 2025 Q1 (batch_692) and 2024 Q3 (batch_683), checked against the trim3 print (pdftotext of pp.2-3 diffed against trim1, plus 110-dpi renders read), the 0925 dictionary, catalogos, raw columns and the .do, not assumed: Q3 2025 1.6 is the Q1/Q3 news-source checklist (14 0/1 indicators bp1_6_01..13, 99), not Q2's household victimization block. Four shipped strings differ from 2025 Q1: (a) 1.2 option 03 (bp1_2_03): Q1 2025 'las calles que habitualmente usa' -> Q3 2025 'la calle' (p.2; dictionary label changes the same way between 0325 and 0925); (b) 1.2 option 12 (bp1_2_12): 'el parque recreativo o centro recreativo' -> 'el parque o centro recreativo (lugar fisico publico con areas verdes, areas de juegos, senderos o caminos, lagos o fuentes, o con instalaciones deportivas, culturales o educativas)' (p.2; dictionary label now 'el parque o centro recreativo'); (a) and (b) are the same rewording 2025 Q2 already carried (batch_696), and both differ from 2024 Q3 (batch_683), so bp1_2_03 and bp1_2_12 are not the same stimulus as in 2024 Q1-Q4 or 2025 Q1; (c) 1.6 option 07 (bp1_6_07): 'Por mensajes SMS o alertas...' -> text layer 'Por mensajes sms o alertas de noticias en su telefono celular' (rendered in small letters, possibly small caps; shipped as the text layer spells it); (d) 1.6 option 99 (bp1_6_99): Q1 2025 'No sabe/ no responde' -> 'No sabe / no responde' (spacing only; same as 2024 Q3). bp1_5_4 carries the 'permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as)?' wording, identical to 2025 Q1 and 2024 Q3. Print-only differences, all in stripped interviewer directions: 1.7 reinstates 'EL CODIGO 3 "NO APLICA" SOLO SE ACEPTA PARA LA POLICIA PREVENTIVA MUNICIPAL', adds 'APLIQUE 1.8 Y 1.9 PARA CADA CODIGO 1 REGISTRADO EN 1.7', 'PASE AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON' (Q1 'PASA AL'), and rewords the skip note; '[CDMX (3)]' row label still printed and kept on bp1_7_1. Everything else in Section I (CP1, all stems, other sub-items, options, fills) is string-identical to 2025 Q1. Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered 2025 Q3 questionnaire wording: 74 of 75 distinct Spanish strings shipped are exact substrings of pdftotext -raw output of trim3 pp.2-3 after whitespace normalisation; the 75th, 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa' (bp1_6_* code 0), is INEGI's catalogo label, as in batch_675/683/692. File = batch_692's with table/section_id/instrument ('primer' -> 'tercer trimestre') changed and the four items above; diffed, nothing else differs. Structure and conventions (batch_675): CP1 in instructions; one section_id per question 1.1-1.9; for 1.2 and 1.4-1.9 stem in section_prompt and sub-item in item_text; 1.1 and 1.3 single items with stem in item_text. Kept as printed: (LUGAR)/(CIUDAD)/(AUTORIDAD), la (al)/la (del)/la (el), gender fills, trailing '?' and '...', 'Otro'/'Otra' as bare words. Stripped: numbers, dot leaders, boxes, write-in lines, ESPECIFIQUE, interviewer directions. Options: only levels present live get rows (no 3 No aplica / 9 No sabe rows; set missing by the .do); 144/144 live item x level cells have an option row. Cross-check (route 9 style, .cache/mexico_2025_q3safety_perception/counts.py vs a server-side GROUP BY item,resp; no export): raw 0925 CSV 23642 rows; .do-expected long rows 1,246,089; live COUNT(*) 1,246,089 over 23,642 distinct ids, 0 missing resp, 0 duplicate id x item -- NOT truncated (unlike 2025 Q1). 144/144 item x level counts identical, e.g. bp1_1 1/2 = 9447/14119 (9=76), bp1_3 1..4 = 5984/4154/7671/5582 (9=251), bp1_2_04 1/2 = 1221/234 (3=22020, 9=167), bp1_5_4 1/2 = 6500/11580 (3=5547, 9=15), bp1_6_01 0/1 = 10305/13337, bp1_6_99 0/1 = 23566/76, bp1_8_1 1..4 = 1387/5689/5136/2595 (blank 8743, 9=92). Id alignment: per-item SUM(id*(resp+1)) server-side equals the raw file with id = row index for 59/59 items. bp1_8_k/bp1_9_k blank in raw exactly where bp1_7_k != 1 (bp1_8_1..6 blanks 8743/5244/2920/2287/11574/6160, 0 blanks with bp1_7_k == 1), per the skip rule. Dictionary defects: Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q3 wave (file suffix 0925) -- same as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_692 (2025 Q1) for every string whose Spanish is unchanged or differs only in case/spacing (bp1_6_07 'Through SMS messages...', bp1_6_99 "Doesn't know / no answer"), and from batch_696 (2025 Q2) for bp1_2_03 ('the street') and bp1_2_12 ('the park or recreation center (a public physical place with ...)'), whose Spanish is identical to 696's; nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section I (questions 1.1-1.9) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, took the 0/1 labels for the question 1.6 information-source indicators (including its 'No sabe / no responde' and 'Otra' indicators, which are shipped as items) from INEGI's data catalogue, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text. In this quarter question 1.2 asks about 'la calle' (bp1_2_03) and a defined 'parque o centro recreativo' (bp1_2_12), not the 'calles que habitualmente usa' and 'parque recreativo o centro recreativo' of the 2024 tables and the 2025 first-quarter table.
